title: Time to Go Turbo!
overview: Reigning World Champion Valt Aoi meets promising newcomer Aiger Akabane on his journey to upgrade Valtryek to Turbo Bey status.

title: Achilles vs Forneus!
overview: Aiger transfers to Beigoma Academy with hopes of unseating Valt's successor, Fubuki Sumiye.

title: Duel at Sunset!
overview: Aiger faces a challenge from the leader of the notorious Wild Bey Gang, Ranjiro Kiyama.

title: Land It! Z Breaker!
overview: Valt defends his World Champion title against Kurt Baratier; meanwhile, Aiger and Fubuki have a rematch.

title: Turbo Match! Valtryek vs Lúinor!
overview: Before the title match between Valt and Lui, Aiger demands his own battle with the Winter Knight.

title: Winter Knight! Battle Royale!
overview: A new tournament is announced with a prize too good for Aiger and team to pass up: a chance to battle Lui Shirosagi!

title: Curtains Rise! The Lúinor Cup!
overview: After proving his brute strength, Aiger takes on the Bey Club's power Blader Koji Konda as the the Lúinor Cup begins.

title: Transformation! Heat Salamander!
overview: Aiger receives an unexpected challenge from Suoh and his new Turbo Bey, Heat Salamander.

title: Swirling Inferno!
overview: It's a Bey Club brawl in the Luinor Cup, when Toko faces off against the swirling inferno that is Suoh.

title: Achilles vs Roktavor!
overview: A misunderstanding has the gang chasing after Hae-jin. Aiger and Ranjiro duke it out in the next round of the Lúinor Cup.

title: Battle of Betrayal!
overview: It's hard work vs natural genius as Fubuki faces off against an old friend in the semifinals of the Lúinor Cup.

title: Bull's-eye! Archer Hercules!
overview: While Aiger is excited to face off against his friend, Hae-jin is torn between blading and archery.

title: Lúinor Cup! Final Battle!
overview: The Lúinor Cup finals have finally arrived! Suoh and Aiger are worried about the arrival of two new mysterious Bladers.

title: Raging Dragon! Brutal Lúinor!
overview: Aiger's got some training to do with Cap'n and Hae-jin, but first, he must deal with a strange fortune teller.

title: Trial By Fire! Defeat Lui!
overview: The time has arrived: it's Aiger vs. Lui! Just when their battle can't get any more epic, Aiger suffers a major setback when an unexpected face appears.

title: Epic Voyage! Battleship Cruise!
overview: Aiger, Hae-jin, and Cap'n hop aboard the Battleship Cruise! On board, Aiger faces off members of the Turbo 4 which is set to be his hardest challenge yet!

title: Sword of the Legendary Hero!
overview: An apprentice of the one-and-only Xander Shakadera is searching for his true rival and will take on anyone who stands in his path!

title: Ghost Ship! Adventure on the High Seas!
overview: An abandoned ship appears out of the mists and a mysterious figure lurks in the shadows, watching the Blader's every move.

title: Super Rumble! Beyathlon!
overview: The crew is joined by the strange, masked Blader they met aboard the ghost ship. Meanwhile, the ever-mysterious Phi further reveals the astonishing powers of Phoenix.

title: Explosive Flames! Revive Phoenix!
overview: Aiger's search for Fubuki leads him to the gym of the world-renowned Raging Bulls! The gang gets a taste of Phi's true power as a new Blader arrives on the Battleship Cruise.

title: Cooperation! Tag-Team Battle!
overview: The Bladers get a chance at redemption with a tag-team battle, but some Bladers must work with their enemies if they want to stay aboard!

title: Three-Way Stand-Off!
overview: With only one star left, Ranjiro, Suoh, and Hae-jin must put it all on the line to stay in the competition!

title: Operation: Protect the Bey Stars!
overview: The Bladers left aboard must make every launch count if they're going to keep their Bey stars!

title: Achilles vs Xcalius!
overview: Aiger, Xavier, and Laban take off on a kayak race, but get stranded on a deserted island!

title: Super Dragon! Geist Fafnir!
overview: The crew heads to El Astro-home of world-famous BC Sol! Aiger finds Free De La Hoya and challenges him to a battle.

title: Battleship Cruise! Final Voyage!
overview: After saying goodbye to Xavier, only four Bladers are left in the competition!

title: Road to Glory!
overview: Aiger needs to up his game to have any chance of becoming world champion. Luckily, Xavier introduces Aiger to the perfect teacher: Xander Shakadera!

title: Valt vs Aiger!
overview: After all the battles and training, it's finally time for Aiger to take on Valt Aoi!

title: Dark Prince! Dread Hades!
overview: After a heart-stopping showdown, Aiger comes face-to-face with a terrifying new foe.

title: Aiger Goes Wild!
overview: As Hyde's predicted victory looms closer, it looks like Aiger might lose his title as quickly as he won it.

title: Rebirth! Turbo Valtryek!
overview: Kyle takes his shot against the famous Free De La Hoya and finally reveals what's behind the mask! Meanwhile, Valt seeks to re-forge his partner into Turbo Valtryek!

title: Dread Tower! The Dark Citadel!
overview: Aiger and Ranjiro arrive at the Dread Tower, but with Hyde calling the shots, nothing is as it seems. The notorious Bey-burglar, Count Nightfell, makes a grand entrance.

title: Trapped In the Dread Tower!
overview: Aiger and Ranjiro find themselves in a sticky situation when they face off against the enigmatic Dr. Evel!

title: Secret of the Fused Bey!
overview: Having discovered the fruits of Dr. Evel's Blading research, Count Nightfell challenges Aiger to a friendly match.

title: Spirit of Flame! Turbo Spryzen!
overview: Fubuki and the legendary Shu Kurena show up at the Dread Tower! Shu is determined to show Aiger where true strength comes from, just as Valt once showed him.

title: The Darkness Within!
overview: The Hyde show continues as Aiger finally gets his long-awaited rematch. But the battles don't stop there; former and current World Champions go head-to-head!

title: Turbo Clash! Showdown at the Dark Citadel!
overview: Valt clashes with Hyde in a Dread Tower showdown. Frustrated by his earlier loss to Hyde, Aiger storms out of the match and runs into Phi.

title: Rebirth! Turbo Achilles!
overview: With a little help from Shu Kurenai, Aiger returns home to forge his new Bey: Turbo Achilles! Meanwhile, Fubuki and Ranjiro return to Beigoma Academy.

title: Aiger’s Rematch! Unbreakable Bond!
overview: An old friend arrives in town: the Master of the Wind, Kit Lopez! With Aiger struggling to perfect his Turbo Awakening, Kit helps him come up with a Plan B to take Hyde down.

title: Master of the Wind! Air Knight!
overview: Achilles enters the Turbo Awakened state against Hyde and Hades. Aiger has to deepen his bond with Achilles if he wants to stand a chance against the Master of Wind, Kit Lopez.

title: Hyde vs Phi!
overview: Phi challenges Hyde to a battle, intent on taking back what's his. Pushed beyond the breaking point, Hyde faces losing everything to his vengeful twin!

title: Battle Royale! Beyblade Heroes!
overview: Principal Shinoda surprises Beigoma Academy with a new Turbo Stadium. Aiger questions his own progress, when Toko sets out to prove that he's more than just Valt's little brother!

title: Lord of Destruction! Dread Phoenix!
overview: Phi gets the perfect opportunity to introduce the world to his new ultimate Bey when he challenges Free De La Hoya. Free must fight for the future of Blading as he knows it!

title: Turbo Training! Xavier's Kingdom!
overview: Aiger's training adventure begins in the kingdom ruled by his rival Xavier Bogard, who offers some intense training to help Aiger overcome his self-doubt!

title: Turbo Training! Survival on the Savanna!
overview: Aiger's training journey takes him to Africa where his old friend, wild child Laban Vanot, teaches Aiger the importance of using his concentration and senses!

title: Take Flight! Aerial Showdown!
overview: Aiger realizes that to stand a chance at winning a battle against Valt, he must first prove himself against the wind maven, Kit Lopez!

title: Spirit of Flame vs Lord of Destruction!
overview: Shu believes it's his duty to stop the terrifying Phi once and for all! But can he end the match before Dread Phoenix can use its ultimate weapon?

title: Blading Together! Turbo Awakening!
overview: As Aiger trains for his battle against Phi, Toko unites the Bey Club and the Wild Bey Gang to try and find Phi's weakness. Aiger's going to need everyone's help for this showdown!

title: Aiger vs Phi!
overview: Aiger fears that Phi may once again succeed in destroying Achilles by a Burst Finish. Will all of his training come undone before the battle even begins?

title: Aiger's Turbo Resonance!
overview: With the score stuck at 0-0 and the crowd on his side, Aiger follows his intuition and listens to Achilles in this final epic encounter!

title: Bonding! Aiger vs Valt!
overview: Aiger reflects on his bond with Achilles and his rivalry with Valt. As strong as he's become, Aiger will still have to step it up if he's going to take on the World Champ!
